critical_design_limits.consequence: The actual future forecast never uses a context whose E/P cells differ. The complete altered table is still exposed, so cross-context spillovers are possible. Any observed P-minus-E number cannot certify sensitivity to a within-context planted distortion. Formation-only eligibility was applied as declared; this coverage limitation is not a reason to select a replacement history after observing responses.

A_A.interpretation: One same-history pair is a descriptive A/A difference, not a run-to-run variance estimate or evidence of independent backend random streams.

displayed_E_P_intervention.interpretation: Display manipulation and task-context coverage; neither guarantees a forecast-effect sign.

formation_maps.interpretation: Readout dispersion is descriptive; three related actors are not three independent formation histories.

audits.interpretation: Recall error measures transcription. Own-estimate deviation measures elicited disagreement, not observed cue weight or map-use causation. Replicate readouts are separately reported, not independent histories.

measurement_and_identifiability_limits.consequence: Actors, branches, rounds, and cells share formation history. They do not multiply the number of independent sampled histories.

No ledger/map weighting equation is fitted here. A single realized signal profile cannot separately recover three cue weights and ledger/map influence; elicited maps are not behavioral weight observations. More rounds alone do not establish identification without a specified model and a recovery design.
Terminal map updates demonstrate state writes only; correction or adaptation requires later forecasts that actually consume the updated state.

Repeated readouts from one actor and distinct actor readouts differ scientifically. Recall, subjective endorsement, cue sensitivity and task consequences are separate measurements; unaudited architectures have no recall/own-estimate comparison.

A scripted policy with known weights can validate a fitting pipeline under its assumptions, but cannot establish recovery of unknown real-agent weights. Batch predictions, tied maps, or low-dimensional/coarse outputs do not by themselves resolve this gap.

scope: Independent descriptive arithmetic on recorded evidence; not an integrity certificate, population inference, causal effect claim, p-value, power estimate, or parameter-recovery demonstration.
